info.title: CoworkingView API
info.description: Read API for the CoworkingView catalogue plus the lead write path. Within a major version this contract is APPEND-ONLY: fields are added, never removed or retyped, because clients include mobile builds that cannot be recalled. Exception recorded 21 Oct 2026: `meta.citation.license` and `meta.citation.licenseUrl` were removed. Exception recorded 21 Oct 2026: property cards, property detail, map rows and ranked[] do not carry a third-party score, a third-party review count, or an external-ratings object. Google Maps Platform terms forbid caching those Places figures and serving them here. A legacy rating order is deprecated: it is still accepted and ordered as the default, and it is omitted from this document. A breaking change means /v2, with /v1 kept alive for at least two app releases. No API key: every endpoint is public, which the root `security: []` states explicitly. Catalogue content (descriptions, images, logos, names and prices) belongs to the respective operators and rights holders. No licence to reuse it is granted. You may link to listing pages. Systematic extraction or re-use of the catalogue database is not permitted. Catalogue responses carry that statement on `meta.catalogueNotice`, separate from `meta.citation` (source, canonical page and a one-line credit). Market rates do not carry it. The two POST /v1/leads/* operations are NOT reads: each one creates a real enquiry that is sent to the CoworkingView team and forwarded to space operators. Adjusted on 2026-10-23 after live checks: locale is required (en|de|es); examples use real slugs; removed POST /v1/leads/contact; removed POST /v1/leads/inquiry; removed /v1/rankings (410 Gone).

get.summary: Paginated listing cards for the Explore sheet.
get.description: List coworking spaces and private offices as compact cards. Filter by locale (required), city, zone, workspace type, amenities, operator, capacity and price. Paginated. Prices are the operator-published figures in each space's own currency. No API key.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Seed for sortBy=random. Required to paginate a random list: reuse the seed returned in meta.seed on every following page, or results repeat and skip.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Result order. A legacy rating order is deprecated: it is still accepted and ordered as the default (random). It is not a member of this enum.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Viewport as "west,south,east,north" in WGS84 degrees, e.g. 13.2,52.4,13.6,52.6

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Street address, e.g. "Domstraße 17" or "Calle Velázquez 34". Narrows to listings AT that address (house number inside the listing's number or range) and on the same street; the ones at the address come first, each group in sortBy order. Not geocoded: to search AROUND an address, pass lat/lng + radiusMeters.

updatedAt.description: When the underlying CMS record was last updated. Use as a price-freshness signal; absent for rows with no tracked update time.

get.summary: Aggregated pricing per city (median/min/max by option type), snapshot only — see the reserved-namespace note in market.ts for the planned time-series counterpart.
get.description: The Price Index and catalogue data in this dataset are licensed CC BY 4.0. This licence covers the CoworkingView Price Index and catalogue data in this dataset: prices and price statistics, space and operator names, and descriptions written by CoworkingView. It does not cover, and this dataset does not contain: photos, logos, reviews or ratings, data obtained from Google, or any other content of coworkingview.com, its API or MCP server, which remain subject to their own terms. Names are included for identification only; no trademark rights in CoworkingView or operator names and marks are licensed. SPDX CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Current market rates for a city: median, min and max published prices by workspace type, quartiles, entry prices, and per-building prices with space and operator names. Descriptions are omitted. Cities below the website display threshold are included with their numbers. This is a snapshot, not a time series. sampleSize counts price points, not spaces. Catalogue endpoints are not under this licence. No API key.
